data.long_meaning: Ajal refers to the present moment or the present time. It is derived from the Arabic root 'A-J-L', which means 'to be present'. This name is often used to emphasize the importance of living in the moment and cherishing every passing moment. The name Ajal carries the meaning “Present, Transient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ajal usually hope their child will grow to embody present, transient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ajal is a name that holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is a reminder of the transient nature of life and the importance of living in the present moment, in accordance with the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Ajal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Present, Transient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: اجل
in_urdu.long_meaning: اجل ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو کسی چیز کے لیے مقررہ وقت کا معنی دیتا ہے، اور قرآن پاک میں بھی اس کا استعمال ہے، یہ لفظ روحانی طور پر انسان کی دنیا کی زندگی کے لیے مقررہ وقت کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अजल

in_pashto.name: اجل
